warnings.title: MAX_CREDIT = 2 clamps the long-run spawn rate at min(cap, 2)/tick — Thread 4's campus types ('campus >> home') cannot emit far more than a home once cap > 2
warnings.evidence: spec: 'Credit is bounded at a burst ceiling MAX_CREDIT = 2 (a terminal may burst up to 2 in a tick after idling; its long-run rate stays the cap)' — a token bucket with ceiling 2 and accrual > 2/tick saturates at 2 every tick and spends at most 2/tick: long-run = min(cap, MAX_CREDIT). cap > 2 ⟺ throughput > 120 u/s (0.5 × T/30), exactly the campus class Thread 4/5.11 introduce.
warnings.detail: 'Long-run rate stays the cap' is false for high-throughput types: the ceiling silently caps a campus at 2/tick = 60 u/s regardless of its throughput — undermining Thread 4's core promise in the same slice.
warnings.recommended_fix: Make MAX_CREDIT type-relative (e.g. MAX_CREDIT = 2 × ceil(cap), or ≥ ceil(cap) + 1) or state the clamp bound explicitly and size it for the campus profile in card 5.11.

warnings.title: Burst-2 on the pre-5.10 access self-breaches email's latency SLA at the spec's own starting values — 60 u burst on a 5 u/s access serializes the second packet in 12 ticks = 600 ms > email's 500 ms tolerance; W10 pins drops, never burst latency
warnings.evidence: spec: 'a terminal may burst up to 2 in a tick' + 5.9 lands before 5.10 (the decoupling) → 2 × 30 u on the 5 u/s narrow: transit = ceil(30/5) = 6 ticks/packet, second packet crosses at 12 ticks = 600 ms · data/packet_types.json: 'email | latency_tol_ms: 500' (verified) · card 5.9 W10 pin: 'zero drops at its own access lane' (drops only).
warnings.detail: The headroom math is average-rate only; a legal burst breaches email latency at the endpoint's own access by design at the stated sequencing (5.9 pre-5.10) — a self-inflicted SLA event of the exact family M6 exists to remove, invisible to every named pin.
warnings.recommended_fix: State the burst×latency interaction in Thread 2/5.9 (burst ≤ 2 acceptable post-5.10 only, or MAX_CREDIT 1 pre-5.10, or widen W10's pin to assert burst-transit ≤ latency_tol_ms).
